Give a look at this.
He gives a look at the paper.
She gave a look at the paper.
They have given a look at the paper.
He is giving a look at the paper.
I give an error.
It gives an error.
It gave an error.
It has given an error.
It is giving an error.
Give a step forward.
He gives a step forward.
He gave a step forward.
He has given a step forward.
He is giving a step forward.
